cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've put your umbrella back in the stand. You'll want it for work. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is it wet? It hasn't rained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I gave it a rinse. I'll dry the handle before you go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's pondweed caught in the spokes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it needs another rinse. Have breakfast; I'll get it back in the stand properly this time.

mechanism: A directs a calm departure while restoring a suspicious umbrella, conceding cleaning details to B so the cause of its condition remains unspoken.
confusable: Unlike admitting an accident and repairing it, A substitutes a cleaning explanation; borrowed authority must preserve B cooperation through service rather than silencing.
comparison: A wet umbrella and work departure differ from replacing a patterned plate while managing a matching Sunday table.
seedUse: Use canonical D37-a wetness/pondweed/rinse chain and S02-a confidently managing an altered plan.
